tactical_states.boundary: Concept support only; no transition probability/effect size admitted.

legshow.supported: Rider introduction/leg-show is a pre-race information phase where riders show intended line formation/order.

weather_wind.supported: Official JMA time-indexed meteorological observations can provide weather/wind source data where station elements are available.
weather_wind.source_caution: JMA notes historical observations may later be corrected and asks users to avoid excessive automated access.

scientific_interpretation: The Reality family can now represent tactical concepts as explicit states rather than burying them in a symmetric scalar line bonus.
This state vocabulary does not establish how often any transition occurs or its effect on winning probability.
Expected/provider line predictions remain lower-evidence PRE_EVENT_EXPECTED_LINE and cannot be upgraded to LEGSHOW_OBSERVED_LINE.
Official JMA weather observations are a viable provenance source class, but race-venue-to-station mapping and capture cadence must be frozen before weather is admitted broadly.
The foundation does not reopen C0/C1/N1/PEER competition or truth-world execution.

next_material_boundary.name: REALITY_VENUE_WEATHER_MAPPING_PLUS_EXPECTED_LINE_PROSPECTIVE_CAPTURE_AND_TACTICAL_RANGE_DESIGN_GATE
next_material_boundary.note: Before tactical truth execution, freeze venue-to-weather-station mappings, obtain repeated prospective weather snapshots and expected-line snapshots, and design broad tactical transition ranges independently of candidate performance. LEGSHOW observed-line transport remains a separate unresolved sub-boundary.
